verdict.rationale: The public guidance pages on inpi.fr (acces-au-guichet-unique, deposer-actes) were retrieved and quoted verbatim, so the reading surface appears reachable without a key. No probe records the HTTP status, user agent, or absence of a bot-management/JS shell for those pages, and the probe note that filing front doors sit behind Incapsula shells leaves the boundary unclear. The Annuaire 403 concerns a different host and is not counted. Missing for 10: a direct probe of inpi.fr guidance pages with an identified UA showing HTTP 200 server-rendered HTML, robots.txt accessibility, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA/Incapsula on the guidance surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
